name: Avenir Wellness Solutions, Inc.
summary: Avenir Wellness Solutions, Inc., operating through its subsidiary The Sera Labs, Inc., specializes in crafting advanced nutraceutical formulations and innovative delivery technologies. Their objective is to maximize product effectiveness and enhance overall well-being. The company offers a diverse range of products across the beauty, health and wellness, and pet care segments, sold under the Seratopical, Seratopical Revolution SeraLabs, and Nutri-Strips brands. Distribution channels include major drugstores, supermarkets, convenience stores, and mass retailers. Additionally, Avenir Wellness Solutions supplies products under private labels to other retailers and multi-level marketing firms, and directly to consumers online, including through subscription services. Established in 2014, the company was formerly known as CURE Pharmaceutical Holding Corp. before adopting its current name in October 2022. Its corporate headquarters are located in Sherman Oaks, California.
